lines.zh: 在水中缓缓游动，发出微弱的咕噜声。
lines.en: Moves slowly, making a faint gurgle.

lines.zh: 用红色和棕色的鳞片，优雅地游过。
lines.en: Swims gracefully with red and brown scales.

lines.zh: 咬住水中的叶子，享受着美味。
lines.en: Bites a leaf, enjoying the taste.

lines.zh: 在石缝间穿梭，寻找食物。
lines.en: Darts between rocks, searching for food.

lines.zh: 在水草中隐匿，等待猎物。
lines.en: Hides in the water plants, waiting for prey.
Jumps suddenly, swallowing a small fish.
Swims to the shore, using the tail fin.

lines.zh: 在水中留下一串串泡泡。
lines.en: Leaves a trail of bubbles in the water.
Gently touches the player with its mouth.

lines.zh: 逆流而上，寻找新的水域。
lines.en: Swims upstream, looking for new waters.

lines.zh: 茶褐色的背脊划开水面。
lines.en: A tea-brown back parts the water.

lines.zh: 顺着花瓣漂来的方向游。
lines.en: I swim the way the petals drifted.
Swims quietly, observing the surroundings.

lines.zh: 缓缓摆动尾鳍，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Gently摆动 tail fin, seems to be thinking.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，让阳光晒暖鳞。
lines.en: I hug the surface and let the sun warm my scales.

lines.zh: 用鳞片轻触水面，发出细响。
lines.en: Taps the surface with scales, making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 在水中静止不动，显得很悠闲。
lines.en: Stays still in the water, looking relaxed.
Occasionally pecks at water plants with its mouth.
Swims in circles in the water.

lines.zh: 用眼睛观察周围的环境。
lines.en: Observes the surroundings with its eyes.

lines.zh: 静静地躺在石头上，沐浴阳光。
lines.en: Lays quietly on a stone, basking in the sun.
Moves slowly, observing prey.
I hover still in the shadow of the blossoms.
My scales mirror the fallen petals.

lines.zh: 慢慢转圈，守着这片水面。
lines.en: I circle slowly, keeping to this patch of water.

lines.zh: 贴着水底的石子歇一会儿。
lines.en: I rest a while against the pebbles below.

lines.zh: 突然看向玩家，发出警告。
lines.en: Suddenly looks at the player, giving a warning.

lines.zh: 迅速游向玩家，准备攻击。
lines.en: Rushes towards the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 用警惕的眼神盯着玩家。
lines.en: Stares at the player with alert eyes.

lines.zh: 游到玩家附近，用嘴触碰玩家。
lines.en: Swims close to the player, touching with its mouth.

lines.zh: 发出警惕的叫声，警告玩家。
lines.en: Emits a warning call, alerting the player.
Gently taps the surface with the tail fin.

lines.zh: 快速游动，试图吓退玩家。
lines.en: Swims quickly, trying to scare the player away.
Approaches the player, gently biting with its mouth.
Hisses at the player.

lines.zh: 用嘴触碰玩家，似乎在询问。
lines.en: Touches the player with its mouth, as if inquiring.
I lift my head from the water to look at you.

lines.zh: 听到岸边的动静就转过来。
lines.en: I turn at the sound from the bank.

lines.zh: 你在池边蹲下，我游近了。
lines.en: You crouch at the pond, so I swim closer.

lines.zh: 花瓣落水，我以为是吃的。
lines.en: A petal falls; I took it for food.
I keep my eye on what you hold.
I drift into the shallows by your feet.

lines.zh: 水面下有一道茶色影子。
lines.en: A tea-colored shadow passes under the surface.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，只是有点好奇。
lines.en: I am not afraid of people, only curious.
Injured, moves slowly.
Scale bitten, hurts a lot.
Fins injured, hard to swim.
Cut, hurts a lot.
Tail broken, can't swim.
Bleeding, hurts a lot.
Injured, slow movement.
Scale torn, hurts a lot.
Scale bitten off, slow movement.
Severely injured, can't swim.
Smell the bait!
Time for a feast!
Sharp teeth, watch out!
Nice bait.
Just a hungry fish.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻，你很快就会消失。
lines.en: Enjoy this moment, you won't last long.
Bait, my target!
You can't escape, I'll eat you!
Come on, I'm waiting.
Bait in front of you, don't miss it.
Move or get hurt!
Don't touch me!

lines.zh: 你撞上我了，现在怎么走？
lines.en: Hit me, now what?
You'll regret this!
Be careful, hard body!

lines.zh: 别撞我，这池子里的怪都被我赶走。
lines.en: Don't bump me; I keep monsters out of this pond.
Don't touch me, I won't be polite!

lines.zh: 你没长眼？这是花影下的池子。
lines.en: Eyes elsewhere? This pond lies under the blossoms.
Hit me, you'll suffer!
Don't touch me, I'll push you away!
Time to mate!

lines.zh: 花瓣落水时，我们该成对了。
lines.en: When petals fall on the water, we should pair.

lines.zh: 找到合适的，我们就繁殖！
lines.en: Find a suitable one, we breed!

lines.zh: 我们需要找个地方交配！
lines.en: We need a place to mate!

lines.zh: 交配成功，我们的后代会更强！
lines.en: Successful mating, our offspring will be strong!

lines.zh: 找个伴侣，开始新的生命！
lines.en: Find a partner, start a new life!
Mate together, pass on genes!

lines.zh: 找个合适的伴侣，开始交配！
lines.en: Find a suitable partner, mate!
Breed, continue the species!

lines.zh: 找个伴侣，开始繁衍后代！
lines.en: Find a partner, start breeding offspring!
Silvery scales gleam, prey in sight.
Seeking prey, ripples on the surface.
Perceiving prey, open wide.
Swim through the school, chase prey.
Deep waters, wait for the right moment.
Prey swims by, strike quickly.
Patiently wait for the prey to come.
Prey near, open mouth to feed.
Joyful chase beneath the surface.
Feast on prey, savor the meal.
Target spotted, closing in silently.
Target revealed, locking on.
Target beside, waiting for the moment.
Target locked, waiting for the right time.
Target in sight, waiting to strike.
Target acquired, ready to feed.
Target secured, waiting for the best moment.
Target nearby, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 花木林的水里，有虫在动。
lines.en: Something stirs in the Blossom Woods water.
Target visible, waiting to strike.

lines.zh: 这片水里没有怪物敢来。
lines.en: No monster dares come into this water.

lines.zh: 我守着的十六格很干净。
lines.en: The sixteen paces I keep are clean.

lines.zh: 有东西落水了，我去看看。
lines.en: Something fell in; I will go see.
The ripples moved, so I swim over.
Who is thrashing in my pond?
I patrol this ring of water.
Targeting, close by.
Target approaching, feeding soon.
Targeting, waiting for the right moment
Target locked, ready to feed.
Target acquired, feeding soon.
Target beside, waiting for the moment
Targeting, waiting to feed.
Target revealed, ready to feed.
Target locked, feeding soon.
Target approaching, ready to feed.
One circle first, to be sure.
I press close and nudge it with my mouth.
One flick of the tail and I face it.
Nothing in the water escapes me.
It is right behind the water weeds.
I ease toward that small disturbance.
Easy now, let me see what it is.
A shadow moves in the crevice below.
Sss, want some fish meat?

lines.zh: 用你的肉来填饱我的空腹吧。
lines.en: Fill my empty belly with your flesh.
Yum, fresh fish meat!
Come, feel my sharp teeth.
You can't escape, my prey.
My teeth are sharp as knives.
Swallow my venom and fall!
Delicious fish, hurry!

lines.zh: 我一拧身，滑鳞擦过你的膝。
lines.en: I twist, and my slick scales graze your knee.
Swallow me and vanish.
I gulp, and water sprays everywhere!
My tail slaps the surface!
I shove the obstacle aside with my mouth!
I twist and ram into it!
I bite down and drag it under!
A splash of thrashing water!
Sss, another prey.
A part of the Silent Forest.

lines.zh: 我要在这片水域中觅食。
lines.en: I'll hunt in these waters.
I'll protect this water.
My scales shine.
Perfect for me to survive here.
Wait for foolish prey.
Guardian of the Silent Forest.
I prevent monster spawn.
Omen of the Silent Forest.

lines.zh: 樱花落在水面，我在这里。
lines.en: Blossoms fall on the water; here I am.

lines.zh: 茶色的影子从水底浮起。
lines.en: A tea-colored shadow rises from the bottom.

lines.zh: 这片水塘多了一条锦鲤。
lines.en: This pond has one more koi.
The petals drifted in, and I followed.

lines.zh: 水底的石缝里游出一条。
lines.en: One slips out of a crack in the streambed.

lines.zh: 我从花影下的浅水出来。
lines.en: I come out of the shallows under the blossoms.
The pool shivers, and I appear.
I was always in this stream.
Burned by flames.

lines.zh: 我从瀑口摔下，鳞片磕在石上。
lines.en: I tumble from the falls, scales knocking stone.
Drowned, can't breathe.

lines.zh: 我这身茶色鳞，被水波掀翻了。
lines.en: My tea-colored scales flipped in the blast wave.
Hit by an arrow.
Hit by magic.
Starving, very hungry.
Hit by lightning.
Fell into void, hurts a lot.
